units.source_text: “新抚子”比喻玉鬘，“有人”指内大臣，“篱根”是抚子所生之处，比喻夕颜。

en.t: The “new pink” is a metaphor for Tamakazura; “someone” refers to the Minister of the Interior; and “the roots by the fence,” the place where the pink grows, is a metaphor for Yugao.

units.source_text: 抚子的别名是常夏，中国称为瞿麦（石竹科）。

en.t: Another name for the pink is tokonatsu; in China it is called qumai, a plant of the carnation family.
